author: KroestV2
body:
By submitting a map to the Avicus, the author of the map basically gives the Avicus ownership of the map. This is very very weird. Why would you ever give someone else ownership of something you made yourself? YOU are the creator of the map right? So why do you ask the rights of a map after the author submits the map to the network? Any decent mapmaker with a logical mindset wouldn't just give full ownership of his wonderful creation to someone else. This network needs good maps to grow, and with this policy you currently have i seriously doubt you'll attract any experienced mapmakers to this server.

You should realize that people sharing their maps with this network without asking money is a privilege.

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Also, funny how if an author requests for their map to be removed, Avicus actually removes it, lol...

Now come on staff, at least change this Policy to something like this:
After your map gets accepted,  we shall use your map(s) and add, edit or remove from the rotation unless the author of the map specifically asks for it to be either: removed, reverted or even changed. The map maker does not have the right to bring back his map into the network, unless an updated version has been made.
Of course changing a map will require you to do the same process of it being accepted, tested, etc.
